D5/S3/PrimeForms/SumTwoSquaresClassifica.name: D5.S3.PrimeForms.SumTwoSquaresClassification.eq_sq_add_sq_iff_even_factorization
D5/S3/PrimeForms/SumTwoSquaresClassifica.signature: theorem eq_sq_add_sq_iff_even_factorization (n : ℕ) : (∃ a b : ℕ, n = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ↔ ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q % 4 = 3 → Even (n.factorization q)
